'''2000 DecipherCon Highlander''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed side event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 6 October 2000. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1310">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-icemans-dcon-2000-reportd1310/ icemans-dcon-2000-report], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 9 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-icemans-dcon-2000-reportd1310/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Highlander]]
